'''Nicolas Gruber''' is a Peruvian and Swiss climatologist. He is a recipient of the [[Revelle Medal]] and an elected fellow of the [[American Geophysical Union]]. He teaches at [[ETH Zurich]]'s Department of Environmental Systems Science.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Nicolas Gruber {{!}} ETH Zurich |url=https://usys.ethz.ch/en/people/profile.nicolas-gruber.html |access-date=2026-08-29 |website=math.ethz.ch |language=en}}</ref>
